SAP SuccessFactors Learning Pricing

Quote-only enterprise module. Sold as part of SAP SuccessFactors HCM. The product page is enterprise-gated.

What is published, and what is not

SAP does not publish a SuccessFactors Learning rate. The product page returned 403 Forbidden at last verification, and SuccessFactors Learning is sold as a module of the SuccessFactors HCM suite rather than as a standalone product. This site does not infer a rate. To get a SAP quote, contact SAP sales.

What SAP sells

Learning inside the SuccessFactors HCM suite

SAP SuccessFactors is a cloud HCM suite acquired by SAP in 2011. The Learning module descends from the Plateau Learning Management System (acquired by SuccessFactors in 2011). It is sold primarily to Fortune 1000 organisations already standardised on the SAP stack.

When this fits

Buyer profile

  • You already run SAP SuccessFactors HCM.
  • You operate in regulated industries with strict audit-trail and validation requirements that SAP’s enterprise documentation supports.
  • Your IT and procurement teams already have SAP enterprise-agreement frameworks in place.
When this does not fit

Reasons to look elsewhere

  • You are not on SAP HCM. Standalone purchase is not a published path.
  • You need a customer-facing or partner-facing portal as the primary use case.
  • You want a fast SMB or mid-market path with published pricing.
